title: Evidence-first latent/Tensor headroom ceiling
primary_claim: Before adding another tensor or embedding subsystem, Daedalus can mechanically refuse to publish a latent-headroom ceiling until the entire frozen failure corpus is measured; predictions and convenient partial subsets cannot license infrastructure.

frozen_experiment.question: What fraction of retained failures have repository evidence that the deterministic Fourfold brief cannot express?

buckets.already_covered: required information is already expressible by deterministic brief/edges
buckets.present_not_expressible: required information exists in-repo but needs similarity/analogy beyond deterministic brief
buckets.absent: required information is not present in the repository and requires execution or requester intent

decision_thresholds.midrange: ambiguous; gather evidence/ablation, do not infer a win

acceptance: invalid schema, revision identity, duplicate rows, unsupported buckets/statuses, and evidence-free rows refuse
only measured rows contribute to bucket counts used for a final ceiling
a partial corpus never emits a numeric ceiling
prediction-only committed seed reports incomplete and cannot license infrastructure
a complete measured corpus computes headroom strictly as bucket-b / total
threshold decisions distinguish close, ambiguous, and one-experiment license without claiming benchmark superiority
